author: Lucifist
body:
Hello! So today, I'd like to cover a topic and also take in your opinions on an idea.

Right, let's start of with the big one. Now, recently we have been witnessing some incredible work being done regarding maps and how well committed and talented people are. And we have thought to ourselves, those people need recognition. Players take time out of their day and produce high quality maps for the Avicus Network. We want to reward them, appreciate them for their work, and more importantly try and give them the recognition they deserve.

Here are some of the ideas we thought of:

1. Exclusive access to the Avicus build server (Temporarily - 1 month)
2. A temporary rank with Gold perks (rank would last a month)

Give us your opinions and suggestions, also, this doesn't necessarily need to apply for map makers recognition can go anywhere.

title: New Rank? Changes? We need your opinion!

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
No.

1. We don't have a build server and at this point we won't introduce one, it's not necessary after all the spinoffs and work done still by the mapdevs to edit maps. We'd also have to have a fine line on what to do and what not to do, as if everyone in the map releases forums were using it the server would constantly crash or have issues to the point where nobody can manage to bring it up again because Kylo is too busy.

2. Gold ranks are useless to someone who is donor, and how would we determine the quality of the map for a rank? If it's a flat map with a monument slapped on and a bridge somewhere, would that be worth free gold? Wouldn't the server lose more money than we already are? At this rate for that case alone it'd kill the server funds exponentially.

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
"1. Exclusive access to the Avicus build server (Tenporarly - 1 month)"
Should be more than a month, some players are slow at building or simply want more time. If your gonna give them temporary access at least 2-3 months, 1 seems way too short.

"2. A temporary rank with Gold perks (rank would last a month)"
Don't we already have this? Last time I checked it was the monthly payment for Gold. Making a "new" rank that essentially is renaming something we already have to trick players into thinking it's some special deal and purchase it. Just keep the regular one, don't go that low like some servers who are looking for money. Yes, the server needs a way to be paid but don't do it by tricking people into thinking it's a "new" rank.

replies.body:

People who deserve it? I think we all know this would lead to bias. How would the Administrators vote or select the candidates?
